description: This file defines the TpmAuth class, a wrapper for handling TPM2 authorization sessions using the tss2_esys library. It provides constructors for up to three authorization handles and accessor methods for each. The class enforces constraints on the number of authorizations used in TPM2 calls.

classes.name: TpmAuth
classes.description: A convenience class for managing TPM2 authorization sessions, allowing up to three authorization handles with enforced constraints.

methods.name: TpmAuth
methods.description: Constructors for TpmAuth class, accepting one to three ESYS_TR authorization handles.
